errors.description: Sign typo in the expanded lower-inequality expression: the correct expansion is (t-y)^2 + 4(t+c)(c-b), not (b-c). The conclusion (5) drawn from it, b - c ≤ (t-y)^2/(4(t+c)), is the correct one, so the logic is unaffected.

parsed.notes: Correct answer f(x)=x+C, C≥0. Substitution x=f(y) gives f(f(y))=2f(y)-y; iterates force d≥0; substituting x=f(t) into both inequalities yields a quadratic Lipschitz-type bound on d, and telescoping over a fine partition forces d constant. Converse is RMS-AM-GM. Complete and rigorous apart from one harmless sign typo.
